title: System for Quality Assessment of Agricultural Product
abstract: Automated system for grading agricultural product quality from computer vision, replacing manual visual inspection with a model trained on the same visual defects an inspector looks for.

title: A Method and System for Encoding and Decoding Data Using Markers
abstract: Method for encoding and decoding data through visual markers, built to be read reliably by a camera under agricultural and industrial field conditions.

title: An Adjustable Apparatus for Uniform Image Acquisition
abstract: Adjustable apparatus that holds camera position and lighting constant across captures, so the CV pipeline downstream gets uniform images instead of compensating for whatever angle a person happened to shoot from.

title: Generic Classification Using Very Less Data
abstract: Classification approach for accurate results with minimal training data, using data augmentation and transfer learning to make up for a dataset too small to train a model from scratch.

title: Cattle Identification Using Face Recognition
abstract: Computer vision system that identifies individual cattle by facial features, for tracking livestock without RFID tags or manual recordkeeping.
